name: Crystal Mask of the Prodigy
body:
Aura moderate clairsentience; ML 7th; Slot head;; Price 10,000 gp; Weight 1/2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This crystal mask allows the wearer to tap into the collective racial memories of the elan. The wearer of a crystal mask of the Prodigy can make Knowledge (psionics) checks with a +10 competence bonus.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special creator must have 10 ranks in Knowledge (psionics); Cost 5,000 gp
